summary: Adagio Medical Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on May 21, 2026, to report the submission of a Premarket Approval (PMA) application to the FDA for its vCLAS Ventricular Ablation System to treat ventricular tachycardia. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 details the PMA submission supported by the FULCRUM-VT pivotal trial (209 patients, 20 centers) showing 97.4% acute success, 84.3% freedom from ICD, 2.4% major adverse events, and 78% reduction/elimination of anti-arrhythmic drug use. This is a regulatory filing—not a special situation—as it involves no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital event. The filing contains no deal terms or financial offers. What to watch: FDA review timeline and potential approval decision, which could affect stock price but does not constitute a special-situations event.
